scenarios.title: Full Multi-Turn Real Card Match Flow
scenarios.description: Multi-turn match executing through production APIs (createGame, game.flow, game.playCard, game.declareAttack, game.declareBlock). Real cards: BS01-002 (Rokceratops), BS01-006 (Merat), BS01-117 (Double Draw). Enforces Turn 1 step skips, cost payments, combat BP comparison, destroyed spirit recycling, core conservation (18 cores invariant).

scenarios.title: Deckout Victory Condition at Start Step
scenarios.description: Transitioning to active player Start Step with an empty deck triggers immediate loss by rule (Eternal Rule 3.5), awarding winReason DECK_OUT to opponent.

scenarios.title: Life Depletion to 0 Victory Condition
scenarios.description: Combat direct hit reducing opponent life from 1 to 0 triggers state-based check resulting in victory with winReason LIFE_0.

scenarios.title: Multi-Hit Combat Across Consecutive Attacks
scenarios.description: Double symbol spirit attacks unblocked twice and then delivers lethal third blow, correctly transitioning Life from 5 to 3 to 1 to 0.
